tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Retrieve Teslemetry's current subscription and pay-per-use pricing, localized to the visitor's region. A price of null means the plan is free.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the visitor's browser to a Teslemetry page: the homepage, pricing, the docs or blog index, or any documentation/blog article path returned by search_docs.

path.description: A site path such as "/", "/pricing", "/docs", "/blog", or a path returned by search_docs.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Teslemetry's documentation and blog for setup guides, integration instructions, and troubleshooting help. Returns matching page titles, paths, and excerpts.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "home assistant setup" or "webhook signing"
